statement: If a word the prior has never met has frame naming mass below a floor derived on the language's own held-out treebank folds (the mass below which only 5% of true naming occurrences fall), then refuse it; expected: a better loss-for-catch trade than the plurality rule (median lost naming 0.049 vs 0.069 at catch 0.33 vs 0.37), but NOT a 5% bound and NO F1 gain (+0.001 fold A, -0.001 fold B).
scope: 25 stems with priors/refusal-<stem>.json; stems where it moves F1 with the same sign on both folds: tur +0.026 / +0.016 (helps), pol -0.005 / -0.024 and vie -0.016 / -0.008 (hurts); other effects are fold-dependent (ell +0.006 / -0.021, eng +0.009 / ~0).
outOfScope: The loss bound it is named for FAILED on held-out text: lost naming <= 0.05 in only 15 of 25 stems (fold A), 12 of 25 (fold B), 13 (DEV); the held-out loss runs 5-7% in many stems; pre-registered PR4, F3 and the t2 prediction all missed and the floor was not retuned. The naive 'refuse below 5% naming mass' is vacuous (catches 3.5% of non-names vs 36% for plurality). R's per-language profile is not stable (fold A vs fold B Spearman 0.127; A and S are 0.987 and 0.87). Needs a conservative (fold-max) calibration on a fresh slice. PRIOR-BASED (frame prior).
observables: The frame prior's naming mass for the word's frame, compared with a floor derived from held-out folds of the treebank (PRIOR-BASED; violates the format-free rule; listed because shipped).
discovery: beings-ladder-results m2 blocks and R main effects (verify-beings.json). Median lost naming loss-bounded vs plurality: DEV 0.0483 vs 0.0764, fold A 0.0491 vs 0.0691, fold B 0.0506 vs 0.0672; median caught: 0.3095 vs 0.3629, 0.3339 vs 0.3707, 0.3123 vs 0.3388. R main effect on F1: +0.0013 (fold A; 8 up, 6 down, 11 flat), -0.0011 (fold B; 8 up, 10 down, 7 flat), DEV +0.0029; interactions with S and A within +-0.0003 (rules add). effect = probability that R helps in a random stem (fold A 0.54, fold B 0.46, mean 0.50).
passIf: On a fresh treebank slice with a fold-max calibrated floor: lost naming <= 0.05 in >= 20 of 25 stems and caught share >= the plurality rule's at equal loss.
failIf: Lost naming > 0.06 median on the fresh slice, or F1 change < -0.01 in more than 5 stems.

statement: If received priors are available, then a form's mean PROPN+X mass (the 'proper' evidence) ranks recurring names at AUC about 0.96, with evidence combined as ORDERED roles (proper first, keyness second: 0.965) rather than a blend (equal four-way blend 0.891); and ranking the ONE-arrival candidates by graded mass recovers single-mention proper nouns at 0.5-0.9 precision, at least twice the base rate in 23 of 25 stems (fold A) and 25 of 25 (fold B), at low recall.
scope: UD stems 24-25, fold A and fold B (priors rebuilt without them); single-mention gold SINGLE = PROPN forms occurring once in the block; graded top-K with K = size of the shipped set (a comparison device, not a proposal). Recall is highest in hin 0.53, urd 0.45, heb 0.36, ell 0.30, ita 0.30; precision highest in eng .82, spa .89, ind .91, por .90, ita .90, hin .88 (base rates 0.09-0.33).
outOfScope: PRIOR-BASED: the evidence is the received treebank POS tally of the same class the gold uses (priors built from TRAIN, gold from held-out slices; circularity of lookup, not leakage). It does NOT replace the shipped gate on recurring gold (G minus shipped -0.177 fold A, -0.160 fold B; 0 of 23 / 24 stems up; DMD weights no better than equal weights, G minus Gq -0.079 / -0.070). Single-mention precision fails in kor (0 of 62 picked right), vie (1 picked), arb (2 of 327; gold names ~0). Bare recurrence is NOT name evidence among multi-arrival candidates (recur AUC 0.465). Not wired into production. The competence card still says R3 fails 23/23 on TEST for the ORIGINAL gate (the lexicon filter ties it); the graded and shipped changes are fold-tested, not TEST-tested.
observables: Per candidate form: mean NOUN+PROPN mass (class), mean PROPN+X mass (proper), binomial keyness against the received rate (key), mid-rank arrival percentile (recur), all from the received priors plus arrival counts.
discovery: rules-structure-results.json (evidenceRules, fold A, candidates with >= 2 arrivals, 24 stems): AUC for recurring names class 0.717, proper 0.958, key 0.681, recur 0.465; blends proper+key 0.959, proper*key 0.957, ordered proper-then-key 0.965, proper-key-recur 0.964, all four equal 0.891. beings-graded-results g0-foldA/g0-foldB (verify-graded.json, 14/14 checks reproduce): single-mention clause 23 / 25 and 25 / 25 stems (DEV 21), e.g. eng precision 0.822 vs base 0.088 (recall 0.134), spa 0.893 vs 0.142, heb 0.797 vs 0.095 (recall 0.360), hin 0.882 vs 0.207 (recall 0.529), fin 0.518 vs 0.158, tur 0.184 vs 0.084; on ALL-PROPN gold (which includes single mentions) graded minus shipped +0.090 / +0.105 (21 / 22 stems up, 4 / 3 down; sign test p 0.0005 / 0.0001) and, as an exploratory aggregation, the equal-weight blend minus shipped +0.143 / +0.144 (25 up / 24 up, 0 / 1 down); mean Born weights class 0.705 / 0.731, proper 0.098 / 0.093, key 0.129 / 0.115, recur 0.068 / 0.061 (cv of the proper weight 1.18-1.22: weights differ by language). effect = AUC of the 'proper' evidence for recurring names.
passIf: On a fresh slice: proper-then-key AUC >= 0.93 for recurring names in >= 20 of 24 stems and single-mention precision >= 2 x base rate (hits > 0) in >= 20 of 25 stems.
failIf: 'proper' AUC < 0.85, or single-mention precision below the base rate in more than 5 stems.

statement: If a form is deleted from a window re-read by the prior-free readers, then (a) the slots that change add exactly over forms that do not touch (slope 1.000, 99.9% exact); (b) a single deletion changes about twice as many slots when the form has exactly 2 mentions in the window as when it has 3-4 (floor cliff: mean 4.17 vs 1.99, ratio 2.09, AUC 0.687), and is flat above that (AUC 0.49); (c) about 70% (wave 2: 59-63%) of mentions of a form with 3 or more mentions change at least one slot and 54% of the change lands on slots the form did not occupy. The cliff is the readers' recurrence floor, a COUNT rule, not a name rule.
scope: 9 licensed corpora in wave 1 (UD fold A: eng fra spa deu fas jpn tur; Ubuntu IRC; War and Peace; Hindi fails the licence), wave 2 replication on UD fold B and new IRC days and a shifted War and Peace grid; window M = 128 sentences (256 messages for IRC); n counted inside the window. The cliff holds in all 12 War and Peace kinds (2.3-3.3 at m=2) and in Pride and Prejudice.
outOfScope: Extensivity: log-log slope of shadow on mentions 0.839 (wave 2 0.750), heterogeneous (Q p < 1e-4; extensive only in German); mentions of one body at n=2 are sub-additive (whole 4.5 vs parts 9.5). Additivity is partly an instrument fact: the extractor is local (93.6% of changed slots are at radius 1; wave 2 92.0%). INERTIA IS DEAD above the floor (Spearman(n, fragility) -0.0094 [-0.029, 0.009], wave 2 -0.0253 [-0.049, 0.001]). The cliff is NOT name-specific: War and Peace cast minus matched controls +0.106 [-0.108, 0.321]; in Pride and Prejudice the slope differs (+0.377 [0.124, 0.641]) only because the reader hears those names as beings (29% of cast tokens vs 7%). Deletion is dissipative (empties 1.18 slots, creates 0.02).
observables: Slot deltas (emptied, retyped, rebound, refilled, shifted, born) from deleting all mentions, or one mention, of a form and re-reading the prefix window; mention count in the window. No priors, capitals or lists.
discovery: physics-handles/results/reader/_report.w1.json and _report.w2.json, recomputed in verify-physics.json (31/31 checks) and verify-physics-auc.json (AUC re-aggregated from the saved single-deletion rows, bootstrap over snapshots). Far pairs: n 1312 slope 1.000 exact 99.92% (wave 2 n 717, 100%); near pairs 0.983 / 0.972 (83.7% / 84.2% exact); informativeness control R^2 1.00 vs 0.54 for a wrong sum. n=3 mentions exactly additive 91.4% / 93.4%. Cliff ratio 2.094 / 2.108; AUC(S at n=2 vs n=3-4) 0.687 [0.674, 0.703] / 0.688 [0.676, 0.702]; AUC(n>=5 vs n=3-4) 0.490 / 0.495 (flat); AUC(n=1 vs n=3-4) 0.377 / 0.384. War and Peace D1 m=1 1.42, m=2 2.77, m>=3 0.99, cliff +1.78 [1.40, 2.17] (P&P +1.69 [1.29, 2.02]); 78% of the cliff survives within-sentence company shuffle. Collateral share 0.539 [0.533, 0.545] (wave 2 0.526). effect = AUC(S at n=2 vs n=3-4), wave 1.
passIf: On UD fold B languages not yet read and new IRC days: far-pair slope within [0.95, 1.05], cliff AUC >= 0.65 with the n>=5 vs n=3-4 AUC inside [0.45, 0.55].
failIf: Far-pair slope outside [0.85, 1.15], or the cliff AUC < 0.58, or fragility becomes monotone in n above the floor (Spearman below -0.05 with interval).

statement: If a form has at least 8 mentions in a corpus of at least about 10^4 mentions, then the company it keeps is measurably above random placement and falls steeply with distance (amplitude sqrt of excess coincidence 0.25-0.35 at one token, 0.15-0.18 at two, 0.06-0.10 at three to four, 0.010-0.017 at 65-128); within-sentence shuffling removes the near field (near ratio median 0.02) and sentence-order shuffling removes the far field (median 0.01); at sentence scale the burst memory decays exponentially.
scope: 33 corpora (24 languages on two held-out folds, Ubuntu IRC, NUS SMS, CoSEM Singlish, War and Peace); 24 of 33 have >= 6 of 8 lag bins above the null band; informal English local exponent IRC 0.80 [0.78, 0.84], SMS 0.66, CoSEM 0.82, formal English 0.86; burst memory exponential with lambda 3-10 sentences (chat, treebank slices) and 30-36 (IRC, War and Peace); reader locality law r^-1.52 [1.38, 1.69] beyond two tokens, power beats exponential 9/9 (wave 2 1.45 [1.32, 1.92], 7/8).
outOfScope: NOT a power law with a stable exponent: power beats exponential in only 20 of 31 fitted corpora (65%), median alpha 1.14 (0.90-1.42) outside the predicted range; fold-to-fold Spearman -0.11 (13 powered languages; 0.13 over all 21), median |difference| 0.22; not family-specific (permutation p 0.039 fold A, 0.73 fold B). 9 of 33 corpora are under the 10^4-mention power floor. Per-neighbour pull is weaker for frequent bodies (median rho -0.12; 21 of 33). ud-fra-A (sentences not in discourse order) has burst L = 0 by design. Warp is not gravity (partial rho -0.06). The vacuum band slope is -0.14 to -0.35, not -0.5. 94% of reader change is in the same relation (extractor locality).
observables: Excess coincidence of a form's neighbours in eight dyadic lag bins on each side, against random placement of the same mentions inside the document; within-sentence and sentence-order shuffles as controls. No priors, capitals or lists.
discovery: physics-handles/results/gravity/_report.json (recomputed in verify-physics.json): PG1 24 of 33 corpora (73%; the registered 90% bar FAILED); PG2 power wins 20 of 31 (65%), median alpha 1.14, quartiles 0.90-1.42; PG3 stability rho -0.11, median |diff| 0.22 (13 languages). Controls: within-sentence shuffle near ratio median 0.02 / far 0.98 (24 of 33 met the 75% rule, narrowly failed by count); sentence-order shuffle far 0.01 / near 1.00 (26 of 33 held). Planted-law check (plant.mjs) valid only at >= 10^4 mentions (run 4: 10/10, 10/10, 8/10 recoveries of exponents 0.5/1.0/1.5; null 10/10 returns no law). effect = share of corpora with >= 6 of 8 bins above the null band (24/33), not an AUC.
passIf: On >= 10 further corpora of >= 10^4 mentions: >= 6 of 8 bins above the null band in >= 80% and the within-sentence shuffle takes the near-field ratio to <= 0.10.
failIf: < 60% of powered corpora show >= 6 of 8 bins above the band, or the shuffles fail to move the near and far fields as predicted.
